### hd-trailing-newline
cat <<EOF
hello
EOF

### hd-then-more
cat <<EOF
hello
EOF
rm -f x
### hd-space
cat << EOF
hello
EOF
### hd-bash-body
bash <<EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
EOF
### hd-inline-terminator-eof-at-end
cat <<EOF
hello
EOF
### hd-tabs
cat <<-EOF
	hello
	EOF
### hd-pipe
cat <<EOF | sh
rm -f x
EOF
### hd-two
cat <<A; cat <<B
a
A
b
B
